title: FEMR Repository Reading Atlas

modules.title: Training Config

systems.title: Policy & Repair
systems.summary: 把 observation 转换为 full-6D Delta SE(3) 并写入 frozen GMT reference

modules.title: FrontRES Policy
modules.summary: 同一个 6D actor 由 Stage-1 q29 HSL 初始化, Stage-3 不保留 online HSL anchor
modules.owns: full-6D actor distribution、Stage-3 critic 与 inference boundary; Stage-1 HSL optimizer 只拥有 residual actor
modules.mustNot: 不追加 confidence、rho、authority 或 active-dim action columns
mainRoute: B1 Stage-1: 870D raw + 58D deployment q29 -> 928D combined -> FEMR 158D -> 6D proposal mean; GMT suffix remains 770D
B2 front_residual_actor_critic.py::act(): distribution -> sampled Delta SE(3)
B3 evaluate_segment_actions(): stored action -> log_prob/value/entropy
review: 检查输出始终为 6D
检查 sampled action、mean、sigma、log_prob 同源
modules.gap: 真实 policy distribution 需要 Phase B probe

modules.title: Task-Space Correction
modules.summary: 将 policy residual 应用到 reference 后交给 frozen GMT
modules.owns: Delta SE(3) 解析、执行安全边界与 reference write
modules.mustNot: 不按 specialist family mask policy distribution
mainRoute: B1 frontres_rollout_step.py::prepare_frontres_rollout_step(): policy action -> rollout action tuple
B2 task_space_correction.py: raw action -> bounded Delta SE(3)
B3 task_space_correction.py: correction + noisy reference -> written reference
B4 frozen GMT: written reference -> robot action
review: 区分 raw distribution 与 executed correction
检查 upward dz 安全约束不是 action mask
modules.gap: 实际 written reference 与 robot action 需要 live trace
